## Key results

- Reported relative effect: OR 1.35 (95% CI 0.98–1.86)
- CER (assumed control event rate): 12.0%
- EER (experimental event rate): 15.5%
- ARI (absolute risk increase): 3.5 percentage points (95% CI -0.2 to 8.2)
- RRI (relative risk increase): 29.6%
- NNH 29 (95% CI NNTB 473 to ∞ to NNTH 13)

Notes on these numbers:

- This absolute effect is estimated from an assumed control event rate of 12.0%, so it only applies to patients whose untreated risk is close to that figure.
- Odds ratios overstate risk changes when the control event rate is high (above roughly 10–20 %).
